codeReview.summary: Fail with one blocking issue. `fluxos-cli/ROADMAP.md` accurately marks the three Git deploy commands complete because the current branch ships `flux git generate-spec`, `plan-registration`, and `register-and-verify`. But the new contract suite in `fluxos-cli/test/git-deploy.test.ts` does not model the shipped private-repo planning behavior correctly: it stores and asserts against an unencrypted spec with redacted env fields, while the real Git deploy plan artifact keeps private-repo compose/contacts enterprise-encrypted.

issues.description: The plan-registration stub writes `spec: rawSpec`, `verified: createFluxRequestResult(rawSpec)`, and `payload.appSpecification: rawSpec` for the `--repo-token --enterprise` case, and the later assertions at `fluxos-cli/test/git-deploy.test.ts:486-506` expect `payload.verifiedSpec` and the stored plan spec to expose redacted `compose[0].environmentParameters`. That is not the shipped behavior on this branch. The real runtime encrypts compose/contacts whenever a repo token is present (`flux-mcp/src/index.ts:896-987`), and the canonical Git deploy coverage already asserts that the plan resource spec has `compose: []`, `contacts: []`, and a non-empty `enterprise` blob (`flux-mcp/test/uxTools.test.ts:902-935`). As written, this finalize-only test would pass against a contract that diverges from the shipped Git deploy plan artifact shape, so the review cannot pass.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `cli-finalize-worker` skill does not explicitly tell finalize-only workers to compare test-only diffs against existing canonical runtime tests when the slice is just contract coverage, which made this drift easy to miss.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `.factory/skills/cli-finalize-worker/SKILL.md` only requires auditing the in-scope diff and smoke-checking it. The reviewed transcript skeleton for session `7c51270c-2676-4fa1-8c95-6fccc16b8833` shows reads of the new test, roadmap, and CLI runtime files, but no read of `flux-mcp/test/uxTools.test.ts`, where the existing Git deploy enterprise-plan contract is already covered at lines 902-935.
